ပြုလုပ်၏။ （က） ဖြစ်စေ၏။ （ခ） ဆည်းပူး၏။ （ဂ） အလွန်ပြု၏။

pakubbati：ပ-ကုဗ္ဗတိ
ပြု၏။ ပြုလုပ်၏။ပကရောတိ
DOP: pakaroti pakubbati pakurute pr. 3 sg. [ S. prakaroti], does; acts; makes, produces; induces, presses; pakaroti : S I 66, 14* (na hi nūna tādī ~oti pāpaṃ, Ce, Ee tādisaṃ karoti); It 21, 11* (pahūtam ariyo ~oti puññaṃ; It-a I 93, 11 : ~oti nipphādeti); Pv 36:22 (yo kīḷamāno ~oti pāpaṃ); Sp 219, 11 (kāraṇaṃ hi yasmā … ~oti ca naṃ kattuṃ ārabhati karoti yeva vā tasmā … pakaraṇaṃ cā ti vuccati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr pakaro ti ca); Sadd 509, 10 ; — pakubbati ( and pakrubbati): S I 24, 10* (na hi dhīrā ~anti); Thī 239 (yo … pāpakammaṃ ~ati); Ja III 253, 13* (aphalaṃ madhuraṃ vācaṃ yo mittesu ~ati); — part.pr. ( a ) pakubba(t), mfn. , A I 149, 27* (pāpakammaṃ ~ato) = Ja III 19, 5* ; ( b ) pakubbamāna, mfn. , Sn 790 (na-y-idha ~amāno; Nidd I 91, 3 foll.: puññābhisaṅkhāraṃ … akubbamāno ajanayamāno asañjanayamāno …; Pj II 527, 8 : puññābhisaṅkhārādīnaṃ akaraṇato na idha ~amāno ti vuccati); Ja IV 47, 12* (pharusāhi vācāhi ~amāno; 47, 16´ : ~amāno ti abhibhavanto) quoted Sadd 517, 15 (pakrubbamāno; 517, 20 : pakrubbamāno ti hiṃsamāno); — pakurute : Pj II 169, 15 (sante na kurute iti sante na sevatī ti attho yathā rājānaṃ sevatī ti etasmiṃ atthe rājānaṃ pakurute ti saddavidū mantenti, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se piyaṃ kurute ti; cf Pāṇ 1:3:32); — pass. pr. 3 sg. pakariyati, pakariyyati, Ud-a 40, 32 (avijjādīhi ca saṅkhārādayo pabhavanti pakariyanti cā ti te tesaṃ pabhavo pakati ca, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ca kariyanti); Sadd 509, 16 (pakariyyati); — pp pakata , mfn. , 1. [ S. prakṛta] ( i ) made (of); done; produced; Abh 315; D III 171, 22* (~ena kammunā); S I 135, 8* (kenāyaṃ ~o satto kuvaṃ sattassa kārako); A I 136, 15* (yaṃ tena ~aṃ kammaṃ appaṃ vā yadi vā bahuṃ); Sn 286 (yaṃ tesaṃ ~aṃ āsi dvārabhattaṃ upaṭṭhitaṃ saddhāpakataṃ esānaṃ); Ja IV 4, 9* (kiṃ pāpaṃ ~aṃ mayā); 380, 12* (annaṃ tava idaṃ ~aṃ yassasi; 380, 16´ : ~an ti paṭiyattaṃ); VI 244, 3* (guṇā mam’ ete ~ā purāṇā; 244, 8´ foll.: mayā purimabhave katā ti dasseti); Nidd I 32, 23* (attanā ~aṃ pāpaṃ, Ee, Se so; Be hi kataṃ; Ce va kataṃ; quoting Dhp 165: Ce, Ee, Se va kataṃ; Be hi kataṃ); Mil 218, 12 (api nu kho taṃ mahārāja maṇiratanaṃ tassa ~an ti); Sadd 794, 17 (tena vatthunā ~am icc etasmiṃ atthe ca mayapaccayo hoti: suvaṇṇena ~aṃ suvaṇṇamayaṃ); 881, 29 (abhinipphanne ~aṃ); — ifc see dosa- ( sv dosa 2 ); — ( ii ) mentioned; (a rule) under discussion; Sadd 920, 15 ; — 2. induced; harrassed; pressed; beset by; Vin II 7, 19 (api ssu bhikkhū ~ā parivāsaṃ dentā mūlāya paṭikassantā …, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se pakatattā; Sp 1157, 21 : ~ā ti api ssu bhikkhū niccavyāvaṭā honti, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se pakatattā ti); Th 271 (ahaṃ middhena ~o vihārā upanikkhamiṃ; Th-a II 112, 19 : middhena abhibhūto); Ja VI 515, 10* (kaccāmittehi ~o; 515, 15´ : ~o ti abhibhūto); 525, 15* (tumhehi brahme ~o atidānena khattiyo; 525, 19´ : ~o ti upadduto pīḷito); Mp II 209, 26 (lobhapakatan ti lobhena ~aṃ, lobhābhibhūtena luddhena hutvā katakamman ti attho); — ifc see ājīvikā-, icchā-, issā-, moha-, lobha-; — pakataṃ in Ce, Ee at Ud-a 324, 15 is wr for pākaṭaṃ ( Be, Se so ); — pakatā in Ee at Ud-a 260, 2 is wr for pākaṭā ( Be, Ce, Se so ).

（၁） ပျက်စီး၏၊ ဖောက်ပြန်၏။ （၂） အမျက်ထွက်၏၊ စိတ်ဆိုး၏။

DOP: pakuppati pr. 3 sg. [ S. prakupyati], is agitated, is disturbed; is enraged, becomes angry; M I 187, 15 (bāhirā āpodhātu ~ati sā gāmaṃ pi vahati nigamaṃ pi vahati; Ps II 227, 23 : ~atī ti oghavasena vaḍḍhati samuddato vā udakaṃ uttarati); A III 243, 5* (upari bhikkhave ākāse tejodhātu ~ati tena uppannā meghā paṭivigacchanti; Mp III 320, 21 : mahā-aggikkhandho uppajjati); Ja IV 241, 4* (sammā vutto ~ati, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se vutto pi kuppati); Cp 2:1:10 (n’ eva tesaṃ ~eyyaṃ); — part.pr. pakuppanta, mfn. , A III 192, 2 (atha vā ~anto paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se atha vā pan’ evaṃcitto); — absol. ( a ) pakuppiya, Mhv 38:38; ( b ) pakuppitvā, Mhv 38:92; — caus. pr. 3 sg. pakopeti , agitates; provokes to anger; — part.pr. pakopenta, mfn. , It-a II 97, 11 (lobho hi lobhanīye vatthusmiṃ uppajjamāno cittaṃ khobhento ~ento … uppajjati); — pakopesi in Ce, Ee at Ap 300, 18 is prob. wr; Be, Se pakappesi; — absol. pakopetva, Pj II 153, 6 (tena domanassena mayi cittaṃ ~etvā); 519, 11 ; — pp pakopita, mfn. , angered; — ifc see parama- ( sv parama 1 ); — fpp pakuppa, mfn. , able to be disturbed, unstable; Nidd I 75, 2 (kuppasantiṃ pakuppasantiṃ).
